definitions: To provide (a book, magazine, etc.) with pictures or other explanatory features.
To serve as an example of.
To clarify or explain by use of examples or comparisons.
examples: The author used diagrams to illustrate the process.
His career illustrates the power of perseverance.
Let me illustrate my point with a story.
pastTenses: illustrated (simple past), illustrated (present perfect), illustrated (past perfect)
